title: The Goldkette band plays his arrangement at the Cinderella Ballroom
summary: Goldkette's band, with Trumbauer and Bix, came through Wilkes-Barre and played his Baby Face arrangement.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: So I had told them about these guys that I knew, he knew about the Scranton Sirens, there was a Cinderella Ballroom there and I said, "Let's go down and listen to the band."

In Wilkes Barre, right on the square. So, we went down and I knew, as I said, I knew Farrar and some of the guys in the band. I went up and talked to them and they played the arrangement. Who was in the band? There was Trumbauer in the band, there was Bix in the band. They now had five brass. Three trumpets, two trombones. Three saxophones. Jimmy had gone to New York and they got Trumbauer in there and Don Murray was a fine clarinet player, he played tenor, so actually it worked out well.
